title: Harden portable plugin workflows without dropping supported runtimes
acceptance: Windows command shims execute through a supported shell-free launch path instead of being passed directly to spawn with shell disabled.
RFC3339 validation accepts valid lowercase t/z and leap-second timestamps while rejecting malformed or calendar-invalid values.
Windows-specific tests skip only unsupported symlink assertions, not complete portability suites.
Node.js 18.18, 20, and 24 remain supported and covered across Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows CI.
The full local test, package, isolated-install, CLI, doctor, and secret-scanning checks pass before merge.
